title: Job Openings at Optimus Bank
content:
Optimus Bank is a digital-driven financial service platform built with a bold ambition of offering optimum banking experiences to millions of customers globally.

We are recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Analyst - Financial Reporting & Finance Operations 

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-ime

Job Description


	Are you an experienced and confident banker seeking a challenging role in our Finance Team?
	We have an exciting opportunity for you!


Primary Responsibilities 
     

            
    




	Preparation of financial statements in compliance with IFRS and regulatory guidelines as may be required.
	Maintaining robust financial controls to ensure accuracy, consistency, and transparency of financial data.
	Coordinating external audit engagements, including preparation of audit schedules and responses to auditor queries.
	Assessing and implementing the impact of new and revised accounting standards on the Bank’s reporting and disclosures.
	Assessing the impact of fair value movements on the Bank’s books and ensuring accurate recognition and disclosure in the financial statements.  
	Managing the daily financial activities and transaction processing on Finacle.
	Oversees product setup and general ledger maintenance in alignment with business unit requirements and CFO directives.
	Ensures compliance with internal controls, finance policies, and regulatory requirements across all operational finance processes.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
	4 - 5 years of experience in financial reporting, accounting, or financial analysis
	Proven experience preparing financial reports and management reports.
	Strong reconciliation skills with the ability to investigate and resolve financial variances.
	Experience supporting month-end reporting and financial close processes.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial analysis and reporting functions.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
	Excellent oral and communication skills.
	Strong communication skills with the ability to present financial information clearly.
	?Interpersonal and conflict management skills
	Candidate must be resident in Lagos.


Benefits
What's in it for you?


	Limitless Growth.
	Positive and Inclusive Work Environment.
	Tailored Rewards and Recognitions.
	Continuous learning environment.
	Health and Wellness Benefits.


Click here to apply online

 

2.) Operational & Sustainability Risk Officer

Job Location: Lagos

Job Description


	The Operational & Sustainability Risk Officer is responsible for supporting the identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of operational and sustainability-related risks across the Bank.
	The role involves implementing the Bank’s operational risk management framework, monitoring key risk indicators, supporting risk assessments and incident management, and promoting effective internal controls.
	The role holder will also support the integration of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) and sustainability considerations into the Bank’s risk management practices, business activities, and decision-making processes.


Key Responsibilities & Duties


	Identify, assess, analyze, and report on adverse risks across the Bank.
	Develop strategies for identifying prevalent risks across the Bank and report the impact of the risks to the Board and Management Risk Committees.
	Develop & Implement mechanisms for early detection of risk trends and implement corrective actions.
	Ensure implementation of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework and other Board-approved Operational & Sustainability Risk Policies across the Bank.
	Proactively measure and monitor identified risks using relevant tools in collaboration with Business Units.
	Monitor key risk trends against internal thresholds and regulatory limits, and escalate breaches as required.
	Responsible for loss incident monitoring, reporting, and management bank wide.
	Embed globally acceptable sustainable practices into day-to-day operations across the Bank and ensure compliance with ESG and sustainability-related regulatory requirements.
	Prepare and submit Adhoc, weekly, monthly, and quarterly risk and Credit Risk reports (internal and regulatory).
	Ensure implementation and ongoing compliance with the Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) in line with ISO 22301 standards.
	Maintain accurate customer credit information on the Bank’s IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) computation tool to support proper impairment assessment of the loan portfolio.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Risk Management, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Environmental Management, or a related discipline.
	3–5 years of relevant experience in operational risk, enterprise risk management, internal control, audit, compliance, sustainability/ESG, or a related field.
	Professional qualification in Risk Management, Sustainability, ESG, Audit, Compliance, or a related field is an advantage.
	Experience within the banking or financial services industry is preferred.
	Good understanding of operational risk management principles, risk assessment methodologies, internal controls, and business continuity management.
	Knowledge of ESG and sustainability risk principles and emerging regulatory requirements will be an advantage.


Benefits
What's in it for you?


	Limitless Growth.
	Positive and Inclusive Work Environment.
	Tailored Rewards and Recognitions.
	Continuous learning environment.
	Health and Wellness Benefits.


Click here to apply online

 

3.) Head, POS Business

Job Location: Lagos
Job Schedule: Full time

Job Description


	Are you an experienced and confident banker seeking a challenging role in the Digital Banking Space?
	We have an exciting opportunity for you!
	The Head, POS Business is responsible for the strategic development, growth, and profitability of the Bank’s Point-of-Sale (POS) business.
	The role will lead the acquisition and management of merchants, drive POS deployment and transaction volumes, develop innovative payment solutions, and ensure the effective management of the Bank’s POS network.


Responsibilities


	Develop and execute the Bank’s overall POS business strategy in line with the Bank’s corporate and digital banking objectives.
	Set and drive aggressive but sustainable targets for POS deployment, active terminals, transaction volume, transaction value, revenue, and profitability.
	Develop strategies to increase POS utilization, merchant activity, customer retention, and transaction frequency.
	Develop and implement strategies for acquiring high-value merchants and businesses across key sectors.
	Identify opportunities for cross-selling the Bank’s products and services to POS merchants.
	Establish initiatives to improve merchant retention and reduce dormant or inactive POS terminals.
	Oversee the deployment, activation, distribution, and management of POS terminals across target locations.
	Ensure effective monitoring of terminal inventory and minimize terminal losses and idle assets.
	Identify opportunities to optimize pricing and improve revenue per terminal/merchant.
	Lead, coach, and develop the POS Business team to achieve agreed business objectives.
	Develop initiatives to improve merchant satisfaction and overall POS service experience.
	Establish effective processes for handling merchant complaints and service issues.
	Use merchant feedback and transaction data to improve products, processes, and service delivery
	Ensure that the POS business operates in compliance with all applicable CBN regulations, payment industry requirements, Bank policies, and internal controls.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 8–10 years of relevant experience in banking, fintech, payments, digital banking, merchant acquiring, POS business, or related financial services.
	At least 3–5 years in a management/leadership role, preferably managing a payments or digital channels business.
	A Master’s degree or relevant professional qualification will be an added advantage.
	Demonstrable experience in growing a POS, merchant acquiring, agency banking, or electronic payments portfolio.
	Strong understanding of the Nigerian payments ecosystem and relevant regulatory requirements.
	Proven track record of delivering revenue and transaction growth.


Benefits
What's in it for you?


	Limitless Growth.
	Positive and Inclusive Work Environment.
	Tailored Rewards and Recognitions.
	Continuous learning environment.
	Health and Wellness Benefits.


Click here to apply online

Regional Project Manager Job at Absen Energy




        
    

        
        Absen Energy, as a wholly owned subsidiary of Absen Group, a publicly listed company whose LED business is already No.1 in the world, has expanded its energy business to dozens of countries worldwide. Nigeria is our first site in Africa, and we will build a high-standard local team here in 2026.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Regional Project Manager 

Job Locations: Port Harcourt - Rivers, Lagos, Kano, Onitsha- Anambra and Abuja

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Regional Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of renewable energy projects (solar installations, mini-grids, inverter/battery systems, and related infrastructure) across an assigned region.
	The role ensures projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality and safety standards, while coordinating closely with Regional Managers, Technical Managers, and City Managers within the region.
	The Regional Project Manager acts as the central coordinator for all active renewable energy projects within the region, from project initiation through to commissioning and handover.
	The role bridges business development, technical delivery, and client relationship management, ensuring that Absen's project commitments are met consistently across all cities/locations in the region.


Key Responsibilities


	Plan, schedule, and oversee the execution of all renewable energy projects within the assigned region, from mobilization to commissioning.
	Develop and manage project budgets, timelines, and resource plans, and track performance against these throughout project execution.
	Coordinate with Technical Managers to ensure system designs, installations, and quality control meet Absen's engineering and safety standards.
	Liaise with City Managers to align local execution capacity (manpower, logistics, materials) with the regional project pipeline.
	Serve as the primary point of contact for institutional, corporate, and government clients on project status, milestones, and issue resolution within the region.
	Identify and mitigate project risks (supply chain delays, site access issues, weather, permitting) proactively across all sites.
	Manage relationships with third-party contractors, vendors, and logistics partners engaged on regional projects.
	Prepare and present regular project status reports, budget reconciliations, and post-project reviews to Head Office/Executive Management.
	Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards on all project sites within the region.
	Support the regional business development team in scoping and costing new project opportunities.
	Conduct site visits and inspections across the region to monitor progress and quality of ongoing installations.
	Drive continuous improvement of project delivery processes based on lessons learned from completed projects.


Requirements
Education


	Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical/Electronics, Mechanical, Renewable Energy), Project Management, or a related field.
	A professional project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is an advantage.


Experience


	5–7 years of experience in project management, with at least 2–3 years specifically in renewable energy, solar, or power infrastructure projects.
	Demonstrable experience managing multiple concurrent projects across different locations.
	Experience working with or managing regional teams and multiple stakeholders is required.
	Must be willing to travel extensively within the assigned region.
	Valid driver's license required.
	Must reside in or be willing to relocate to the regional headquarters location.
	Sound understanding of the renewable energy regulatory environment in Nigeria is an advantage.


Required Skills:


	Strong project management skills (planning, scheduling, budgeting, risk management).
	Working knowledge of solar PV systems, inverters, battery storage, and mini-grid infrastructure.
	Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, across technical and non-technical audiences.
	Proficiency with project management tools/software (e.g. MS Project, Trello, Asana, or similar) and MS Office/Excel.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Leadership and team coordination skills across a dispersed, multi-city team.
	Negotiation skills for contractor and vendor management.


Remuneration


	Salary: N100,000 - N500,000 per month.
	Competitive salary commensurate with experience, to be determined by HR/Finance in line with Absen's salary structure.


Method of Application 
Interested candidates should submit their CV and a Cover Letter to:[email protected]using "Application: [Role] – [Location] (e.g., "Application: City Manager – Onitsha")" as the subject of the mail.

Note


	Remuneration figures have been left as ranges/placeholders for HR and Finance to finalize in line with Absen's internal salary bands and market benchmarking.
	Role title, reporting lines, and responsibilities should be reviewed and adjusted to reflect Absen's actual organizational structure before use in job postings or offer letters.

	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

  "title": "Accountant",
  "description": "Vodstra Limited - Our client, a leading transportation and logistics company with operations across Nigeria and West Africa, is&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Accountant&nbsp;

Job Locations: Lagos

Job Summary

        The Concept Group is a holding company for companies established in 1992. Subsidiaries under the Group include: Rosabon Financial Services - Nigeria’s Leading Financial Intermediary and Equipment Leasing Company, Concept Nova - Bespoke Enterprise IT Solutions Company, Percy Aitkins - Bureau De Change.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Account Executive 

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Accounts Executive to manage financial records, support reporting, and ensure compliance with financial standards while providing insights to improve business performance.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare monthly and annual financial reports.
	Maintain accurate accounting records and monitor budgets.
	Manage cash flow and support cost-reduction initiatives.
	Ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
	Use accounting software and Excel to generate financial data and reports.
	Liaise with auditors, banks, and regulatory bodies.


Requirements


	Degree / HND in Accounting, Finance, or related fields.
	Strong knowledge of financial reporting standards.
	Proficiency in Excel and accounting software.
	High attention to detail and strong analytical skills.


Salary
N250,000 - N400,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
